title: イングリッシュトピックス5
subtitle: English Topics 5
courseType:
English Language Program
English Language Courses
educationalGoal: In this course, students will acquire the ability to discuss various topics in English. In order to do this, students will learn necessary English expressions, sentence structures, and vocabulary. Students will also develop an extensive reading habit.
advice: Students will use a textbook to study various topics. Textbook: Reading Explorer 2 Third Edition Unit 1: Food and Health Unit 2: Call of the Wild Unit 3: History Detectives Unit 4: Traditions and Rituals Students will also study 2 extra readings. The materials will be distributed in class. In class, students are expected to have a positive attitude, to work in pairs or groups, to play English games, to prepare and conduct presentations, and to participate in other active learning activities. Before each class, students must check the student portal and the e-syllabus for any homework or other materials needed for class. Students should also bring a dictionary to every class.

activityGoals.body: Read and understand the contents of the topics studied in class.
For each topic, understand the meaning of important words and phrases and be able to use them correctly.
Understand the main point of sentences and be able to explain the meaning, orally and in writing.
Be able to explain one's opinion about the topics studied in class, orally and in writing.
Improve one's English skills by cooperatively working in groups or pairs.

achievementLevels.ideal: - Can thoroughly understand the content of the topics studied. - Can understand and correctly use the important vocabulary and expressions from each topic. - Can identify the main point of sentences and correctly explain it in English, orally or in writing. - Can accurately express one's opinion about the topics studied, orally or in writing. - Cooperates with groups/partners with a positive attitude to complete activities to improve English skills. - Develops an extensive reading habit outside of class.
achievementLevels.standard: - Can understand the content of the topics studied. - Can understand and use the important vocabulary and expressions from each topic. - Can identify the main point of sentences and explain it in English, orally or in writing. - Can express one's opinion about the topics studied, orally or in writing. - Cooperates with groups/partners to complete activities to improve English skills. - Develops an extensive reading habit outside of class.
